Name: Ishi, Son of Shimon
Summary: Father of Zoheth and Ben-zoheth in Judah's genealogy.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 4:20: Father of Zoheth and Ben-zoheth in Judah's genealogy.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Ishi stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
